[[Dan (TV series)|Dan]] (friend) |role =Unemployed construction worker |height = |eye color =Blue |hair color =Bald |TV actor =[[Christopher Matthew Cook]] |stunt double=[[Frank Trigg]] }} '''Bill''' is a character who appears in the first episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== Bill is a heavyset, bald construction worker dissatisfied with [[RobCo Industries]]' policy of replacing humans with robots. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Innovator]]=== At a bar, he and other protesters from the [[automation riots]] watch a speech by the fake Mr. House, calling the corporation's CEO a parasite and saying he didn't vote for him. He is interrupted by the voice of a stranger (the real [[Mr. House]]), who, on the contrary, speaks highly of House's performance, claiming he has more power than any politician in [[Washington]] and agreeing with Bill's caustic comment that he is House's biggest fan. The stranger begins to discuss obsolescence, but Bill and his friends throw him out of the bar, threatening to beat him up. House demands that Bill punch him in the jaw first, which he agrees to. Afterward, the businessman shows him the trunk of a car containing $31 million in cash, offering him a deal: Bill will keep all the money, but in exchange, he must insert an [[Brain-computer interface chip|unknown device]] into the back of his head, calling it "a little market research." Bill resists the offer, grabs House by the jacket, and threatens to break his hands, which he "never used," and take all the money. But House seizes the moment and thrusts the device into his neck, then orders him to "get rid of his friends," handing him a bat. Mesmerized, Bill beats his friends to death, and House begins to twist the device's switch, causing Bill's head to explode. After picking up the chip, Mr. House concludes that "the world may end, but technology will continue to advance." ==Appearances== Bill appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|9=201}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
